ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is square ABCE, with vertex order A at the upper left, B at the upper right, C at the lower right, and E at the lower left. Point F is on the left side AE, point D is on the bottom side EC, and BF, FD, DB are connected, forming triangle BFD. Reasoning: Take the side length of the square as 3 according to the specified method, and set E=(0,0), A=(0,3), B=(3,3), C=(3,0). From AF=2FE, it can be known that AE is divided into AF:FE=2:1, so FE=1, hence F=(0,1). From CD=2DE, it can be known that EC is divided into ED:DC=1:2, so ED=1, hence D=(1,0). The area of triangle BFD is calculated using a determinant: F-B=(0,1)-(3,3)=(-3,-2), D-B=(1,0)-(3,3)=(-2,-3). det(F-B,D-B)=(-3)(-3)-(-2)(-2)=9-4=5, so the area is 1/2*5=5/2. The area of the square is 3^2=9. Therefore the required ratio is (5/2)/9=5/18.

method.method_draft: Use coordinates with a convenient side length. From the image, take the square ordered as A top-left, B top-right, C bottom-right, E bottom-left, with F on AE and D on EC. From the text, AF=2FE means EF is one third of the side, and CD=2DE means ED is one third of the side. Set the square side to 3: E=(0,0), A=(0,3), B=(3,3), C=(3,0), so F=(0,1) and D=(1,0). Compute the area of triangle BFD by the determinant/shoelace formula: area = 1/2 |det(F-B, D-B)| = 5/2. The square area is 9, so the ratio is (5/2)/9 = 5/18.

method.method_draft: Use area subtraction inside the square. From the image, the segments BF, FD, and DB divide the square into triangle BFD plus three corner triangles: ABF, BCD, and EFD. Let the square side be s. From the text, AF=2FE gives AF=2s/3 and FE=s/3; CD=2DE gives CD=2s/3 and DE=s/3. Then area(ABF)=1/2·AB·AF=1/2·s·(2s/3)=s^2/3. Similarly area(BCD)=1/2·BC·CD=s^2/3. Also area(EFD)=1/2·EF·ED=1/2·(s/3)(s/3)=s^2/18. Therefore area(BFD)=s^2 - s^2/3 - s^2/3 - s^2/18 = 5s^2/18, so the desired ratio is 5/18.

设正方形边长为s。由AF=2FE可知，AE被分成3份，所以AF=2s/3，FE=s/3。由CD=2DE可知，CD=2s/3，DE=s/3。

于是：
area(ABF)=1/2·AB·AF=1/2·s·(2s/3)=s^2/3。
area(BCD)=1/2·BC·CD=1/2·s·(2s/3)=s^2/3。
因为E是正方形的直角顶点，所以EF⊥ED，
area(EFD)=1/2·EF·ED=1/2·(s/3)·(s/3)=s^2/18。

正方形面积为s^2，所以
area(BFD)=s^2-s^2/3-s^2/3-s^2/18
=s^2·(1-1/3-1/3-1/18)
=s^2·5/18。

因此，triangle BFD与正方形ABCE的面积比为5/18。Final answer: 5/18。
